# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "ggtext")

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment
set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
```

# Data

```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/pathogenwatch/curated/pathogenwatch_data.RDS",
  c(
    "pathogenwatch_isolate_data",
    "resistance_variables",
    "mutation_variables"
  )
)
 
ng_overall_meta <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  mutate(study = "Overall")

ng_chosen_meta <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(is_chosen) %>%
  mutate(study = "Chosen")

ng_overlay_meta <- bind_rows(ng_overall_meta, ng_chosen_meta)
```

# overlay plot with * for significance

```{r}

# decade

decade_overlay <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_decade)) %>%
  count(collection_decade, study) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(perc = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

decade_pvals <- lapply(sort(unique(ng_overlay_meta$collection_decade[!is.na(ng_overlay_meta$collection_decade)])), function(d) {
  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>% filter(!is.na(collection_decade))
  in_group <- tmp$collection_decade == d
  tbl <- table(
    factor(in_group, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )
  data.frame(collection_decade = d, p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value)
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

decade_overlay <- left_join(decade_overlay, decade_pvals, by = "collection_decade")

A_overlay <- ggplot(decade_overlay,
                    aes(x = factor(collection_decade),
                        y = perc,
                        fill = study)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    data = decade_overlay %>%
      group_by(collection_decade) %>%
      slice_max(perc, n = 1) %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = "*"),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5
  ) +
  study_fill_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Decade") +
  ylab("Percentage (%)")
```

```{r}
# continent
continent_overlay <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_continent)) %>%
  count(collection_continent, study) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(perc = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

continent_pvals <- lapply(sort(unique(ng_overlay_meta$collection_continent[!is.na(ng_overlay_meta$collection_continent)])), function(ct) {
  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>% filter(!is.na(collection_continent))
  in_group <- tmp$collection_continent == ct
  tbl <- table(
    factor(in_group, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )
  data.frame(collection_continent = ct, p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value)
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

continent_overlay <- left_join(continent_overlay,
                               continent_pvals,
                               by = "collection_continent")

continent_order <- continent_overlay %>%
  filter(study == "Overall") %>%
  arrange(desc(perc)) %>%
  pull(collection_continent)

continent_overlay$collection_continent <- factor(
  continent_overlay$collection_continent,
  levels = continent_order
)

B_overlay <- ggplot(continent_overlay,
                    aes(x = reorder(collection_continent, -perc),
                        y = perc,
                        fill = study)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    data = continent_overlay %>%
      group_by(collection_continent) %>%
      slice_max(perc, n = 1) %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = "*"),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5
  ) +
  study_fill_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Continent") +
  ylab("Percentage (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = 1,vjust=0.5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,10,20,30,40,50),limits = c(NA,(ceiling(max(continent_overlay$perc) /10)*10+3)))
```

```{r}
# ST (major only)
sequence_types <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence_type)) %>%
  count(sequence_type, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(perc = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

N_TOP <- 51
top_sequence_types <- sequence_types %>%
  slice_head(n = N_TOP) %>%
  pull(sequence_type)

st_overlay <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence_type), sequence_type %in% top_sequence_types) %>%
  count(sequence_type, study) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(perc = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

st_pvals <- lapply(sort(unique(ng_overlay_meta$sequence_type[!is.na(ng_overlay_meta$sequence_type) & ng_overlay_meta$sequence_type %in% top_sequence_types])), function(s) {
  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
    filter(!is.na(sequence_type), sequence_type %in% top_sequence_types)
  in_group <- tmp$sequence_type == s
  tbl <- table(
    factor(in_group, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )
  data.frame(sequence_type = s, p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value)
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

st_overlay <- left_join(st_overlay, st_pvals, by = "sequence_type")

st_order <- st_overlay %>%
  filter(study == "Overall") %>%
  arrange(desc(perc)) %>%
  pull(sequence_type)

st_overlay$sequence_type <- factor(st_overlay$sequence_type, levels = st_order)

C_overlay <- ggplot(st_overlay,
                    aes(x = reorder(sequence_type, -perc),
                        y = perc,
                        fill = study)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    data = st_overlay %>%
      group_by(sequence_type) %>%
      slice_max(perc, n = 1) %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = "*"),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5
  ) +
  study_fill_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Sequence type") +
  ylab("Percentage (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = 1,vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
# resistance pheno
res_overlay <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  select(genome_id, study, all_of(resistance_variables)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(resistance_variables),
               names_to = "Antibiotic",
               values_to = "Status") %>%
  mutate(binary = Status != "NOT_FOUND") %>%
  group_by(Antibiotic, study) %>%
  summarise(perc = 100 * mean(binary),
            .groups = "drop")

res_pvals <- lapply(resistance_variables, function(x) {
  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
    mutate(binary = .data[[x]] != "NOT_FOUND")
  tbl <- table(
    factor(tmp$binary, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )
  data.frame(
    Antibiotic = x,
    p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

res_overlay <- left_join(res_overlay, res_pvals, by = "Antibiotic")

res_order <- res_overlay %>%
  filter(study == "Overall") %>%
  arrange(desc(perc)) %>%
  pull(Antibiotic)

res_overlay$Antibiotic <- factor(res_overlay$Antibiotic, levels = res_order)

D_overlay <- ggplot(res_overlay,
                    aes(x = reorder(Antibiotic, -perc),
                        y = perc,
                        fill = study)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    data = res_overlay %>%
      group_by(Antibiotic) %>%
      slice_max(perc, n = 1) %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = "*"),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5
  ) +
  study_fill_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Antibiotic") +
  ylab("Resistance (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = 1,vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
# genotype
mut_overlay <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
  select(genome_id, study, all_of(mutation_variables)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(mutation_variables),
               names_to = "Genotype",
               values_to = "Presence") %>%
  mutate(Presence = as.numeric(as.character(Presence))) %>%
  group_by(Genotype, study) %>%
  summarise(perc = 100 * mean(Presence),
            .groups = "drop")

mut_pvals <- lapply(mutation_variables, function(x) {
  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
    mutate(binary = as.numeric(.data[[x]]) > 0)
  tbl <- table(
    factor(tmp$binary, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )
  data.frame(
    Genotype = x,
    p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
 
## derive locus from genotype name
mut_overlay_locus <- mut_overlay %>%
  mutate(Locus = sub("_.*", "", Genotype)) %>%
  group_by(Locus, study) %>%
  summarise(
    perc = mean(perc),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mut_pvals_locus <- lapply(unique(mut_overlay_locus$Locus), function(lc){

  tmp <- ng_overlay_meta %>%
    select(genome_id, study, all_of(mutation_variables)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(mutation_variables),
                 names_to = "Genotype",
                 values_to = "Presence") %>%
    mutate(
      Locus = sub("_.*", "", Genotype),
      Presence = as.numeric(as.character(Presence))
    ) %>%
    group_by(genome_id, study, Locus) %>%
    summarise(binary = any(Presence > 0),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(Locus == lc)

  tbl <- table(
    factor(tmp$binary, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    factor(tmp$study, levels = c("Overall", "Chosen"))
  )

  data.frame(
    Locus = lc,
    p_value = fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  )

}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

mut_overlay_locus <- left_join(mut_overlay_locus,
                               mut_pvals_locus,
                               by = "Locus")

mut_overlay_locus$Locus <-  paste0("<i>",mut_overlay_locus$Locus,"</i>") %>% gsub("<i>blaTEM</i>","<i>bla</i><sub>TEM</sub>",.)

locus_order <- mut_overlay_locus %>%
  filter(study == "Overall") %>%
  arrange(desc(perc)) %>%
  pull(Locus)

mut_overlay_locus$Locus <- factor(mut_overlay_locus$Locus, levels = locus_order)

E_overlay <- ggplot(mut_overlay_locus,
                    aes(x = Locus,
                        y = perc,
                        fill = study)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    data = mut_overlay_locus %>%
      group_by(Locus) %>%
      slice_max(perc, n = 1) %>%
      filter(p_value < 0.05),
    aes(label = "*"),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5
  ) +
  study_fill_scale +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Genetic locus") +
  ylab("Presence (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90,hjust = 1,vjust=0.5))
```

```{r,fig.width=8.5,fig.height=8.5}
# combine
overlay_figure_star <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::plot_grid(A_overlay + theme(legend.position='none'), B_overlay + theme(legend.position='none'),D_overlay + theme(legend.position='none'), labels = c("A","B","D"),rel_widths = c(1,0.5,0.5),ncol=3),
  cowplot::plot_grid(C_overlay + theme(legend.position='none'), labels = c("C"),rel_widths = c(1)),
  cowplot::plot_grid(E_overlay, labels = "E"), # swap all muts to bottom, grouped muts to top
  ncol = 1
)
```
